clause_ledger.question_quote: If a constricted card reaches slot 1 or 2, can it be used
clause_ledger.requirement: Resolve regular-action usability in the specified low slots: it cannot execute as-is at effective strength zero or below, but enough X-tokens can restore it to at least one.

summary_support.text: **Your zoo map:** buildings go in the large central area. You may not build on rock and water spaces (some animals need an enclosure next to rock or water). A built-on space is "covered." Spaces with a special icon may not be built on until you upgrade your Build Action card. Some spaces show a **placement bonus**, gained immediately when you cover them. The left edge holds the 7 player tokens used to support conservation projects (each grants a bonus when taken — always immediately, and some again in each break). The bottom has 5 card slots for your Action cards; the number above each slot is that card's strength. The right side has spaces for partner zoos (5 continents exist, but you can partner with a maximum of 4 — the third requires an upgraded Association action) and universities (3 different ones); fill each column bottom-up and take any bonus printed on a space you cover immediately. Workers, money, and X-tokens live on the notepad.

**X-tokens.** You may use X-tokens to increase an action's strength: each token spent adds +1 strength, then returns to the supply. You may spend any number in one action (for some actions, strength above 5 no longer improves the action). You can never hold more than 5 X-tokens. Bonuses gained earlier in an action, including money, cards and newly activated workers, may be used for later steps of that action; resolve its items one at a time. You must pay each item before receiving its own benefits. You set the strength **before** performing the action — X-tokens gained while performing an action cannot boost that same action.

- **Constriction — affected players and card ownership:** every affected **other zoo** (at least 5 appeal and ahead of yours on appeal and/or conservation) places tokens on **that affected zoo’s own Action cards**. Ahead on one track: one token on **its slot-5 card**. Ahead on both tracks: one token on **each of its slot-4 and slot-5 cards**. Never stack two Constriction tokens on one card; return duplicates. An affected action loses two strength; this applies to each execution of a multiplied action. X-tokens can restore strength. At effective strength zero or below, use enough X-tokens to reach at least one, use the alternative X-token action, or leave the card until it is at least in slot 3. Return the token after acting, or without effect in the break.
